newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Brent/Dubai steady in Asia, Tapis paper weakens.
newsitem.headline: Brent/Dubai steady in Asia, Tapis paper weakens.

text.p: The Brent/Dubai spread for November was steady in Asia on Monday compared with late Friday levels.
It was assessed at $2.25/$2.35 per barrel, similar to late Friday levels in London.
December notionally straddled $2.00 at $1.98/$2.08, two cents down on late Friday.
Dubai intermonth spreads were mostly steady at around 40 cents with November/December at 37/44, December/January at 35/43, while January/February was quoted at 35/40.
Brokers said paper Tapis weakened 30 to 35 cents on Monday, in line with the weakness seen on NYMEX crudes.
October paper Tapis was quoted at $22.20/$22.40, down from $22.50/$22.70 on Friday with October around a 25-cent backwardation.
NYMEX October crude was last traded in Asian time at $24.15 on the ACCESS after-hours system, down 36 cents from the New York close on Friday of $24.51.
